title: Seed role descriptions in default_config and add read-before-assign reminders
action: (1) onboard/templates.rs default_config: the four seeded claude roles become {model, description} objects — code: write the cell's code and its tests; read: multi-file gathers and scans, read-only; extraction: narrow fact lookups from known locations; generation: fall-through tail, the default writer role. Codex seeds stay null. Update seed-shape tests (default_config_keeps_literal_order_and_nulls, default_config_publishes_only_the_roles_bee_asks_for, and any host_opted_into_roles/agents sync tests that read the seeds). (2) The missing-role refusal in cells validation and the cells-add role help sentence in catalog.rs both name the verb with the reminder: if the role table has not been read this session, run bee models show before assigning — replacing guess-and-fill. Regenerate registry_payload.json.

truths: A fresh default_config carries a description on each of the four seeded claude roles and resolution still yields the same models
The missing-role refusal text names bee models show as the read-first step
bee cells add --help names bee models show beside the existing description teach line

verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee onboard cells — green with updated seed and refusal tests named in the output; bee dev regen green
notes: PBI p-0a5e6c44 CoS 3+4. Depends on ms-1 for the verb name existing in catalog.rs (shared file — never run concurrently with ms-1).
